worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.summary: Scoops up a fistful of sand heated by the earth and flings it at a point: the sand arcs to the landing spot, bursts open, scalds everyone inside and may set them alight, and the ground there is baked into a crust of hot sand. Standing on sand scoops more, and scorching sand sticks worse to a wet target.
worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.use.0: Scald a group around a point with a fistful of hot sand
worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.use.1: Coat the ground in sand to lock down a patch
worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.use.2: Scoop more sand and spread wider on sandy ground
worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.use.3: Scorch a wet target for extra damage
worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.descrip: The burst deals %1$s special damage to each body inside; their special defence, type matchup and criticals are settled on impact.
Range %1$s blocks; the sand flies at %2$s blocks/tick and bursts in a %3$s block radius.
Bodies inside have a %1$s chance to be set alight; the landing ground is baked into about %2$s blocks of sand crust for %3$s s.
In smoulder mode, standing on the sand takes %1$s damage every %2$s s, and stepping in has a %3$s burn chance.
worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.rule.sa: The landing ground is baked into a crust of hot sand (a leased coat that returns the original blocks when it expires); a user standing on sand or sandstone scoops more, for a wider crust and denser visuals. A wet target is scorched worse: hit damage x1.15.
Smoulder: x0.88 burst power, but the sand left behind keeps smouldering, burns more readily on entry and lasts longer, with +8 cooldown.
Red sand: x1.08 burst power, and the sand just lies there, with -3 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
From level %1$s the burst rises to %2$s power and %3$s burn chance.
From level %1$s the burst rises to %2$s power and the radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.scorchingsands.prefere: On: x0.88 burst power, but the sand left behind keeps smouldering, burns more readily on entry and lasts longer, with +8 cooldown, for locking down ground. Off (red sand): x1.08 burst power and inert sand, with -3 cooldown, for burst.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger prefers opening from farther away.
On: a target with other enemies nearby ranks first so the fistful covers them too; off: order by ordinary ranged attack only.
